referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Leon's website in New York, New York uses a bright interior carousel beneath a centered typographic identity. Navigation is cream navigation row with immediate reserve, menu and hours links. Its page moves through interior photo opening, hours introduction, featured dish vignette, private dining feature, restaurant story, food-photo close, contact footer, with service decisions are reservation, menu, hours and private dining rather than a service grid. interior and food photos in alternating half-width compositions. Transferable mechanics are cream and green palette, interior carousel, alternating food editorial. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
